newsitem.title: USA: 99 Cents Only Q1 same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: 99 Cents Only Q1 same store sales rise.

text.p: 99 Cents Only Stores said its same store sales rose 2.4 percent in the first quarter ended March 31, excluding new stores that were opened within three miles of existing stores.
Including the adjustment, same store sales were up 0.1 percent, 99 Cents said in a statement issued late on Tuesday.
Total first quarter sales rose to $50.7 million, a 20 percent increase over $42.3 million in first quarter 1996.
Of the total, sales at retails stores rose to $39.2 million, up 21.4 percent from $32.2 million last year, and wholesales sales rose to $11.6 million, up 15.6 percent.

99 Cents said it opened two stores during the first quarter of 1997 boosting the total store count to 45 at March 31. The company has secured locations for five more stores. It plans to open new stores at an annual growth rate of at least 20 percent.
